title: Build a video team you can inspect
audience: small teams producing software launch videos
objective: Explain what VideoOps Factory does, its setup requirements, review limits, and how to try it. Produce a sourced article, newsletter, three social posts, and a local landing page.
voice: Plain, direct, practical. Lead with the benefit. No invented first-person biography or hype.
constraints: Distinguish bare Ubuntu installation from prerequisites-already-installed timings and extra sign-in.
The owner reported a busy host and limited available memory. Contention and swapping were not measured.
Rendered videos still require perceptual review. Do not imply autonomous approval.
